meta.name: financial-modeling
meta.description: Builds and stress-tests financial models for forecasting, scenario planning, and decision support — revenue build, cost structure, driver logic, and the sensitivities that show where a plan breaks. Use this to model a decision's financial consequence, build a forecast or long-range plan, evaluate an investment or hire, or pressure-test someone else's model before relying on it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立并压力测试财务模型，预测经营结果并找出计划脆弱点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做决策前需要先算清财务后果。
copy.tagline_en: Build and stress-test financial models to see where your plan breaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to weigh the financial consequences of a decision before committing.

howto.what: 他会帮你构建并压力测试财务模型：先分假设、计算、结果三层，再按业务驱动因素推收入，找出最敏感的假设和盈亏平衡点，也会审查他人模型。
howto.when: 当你提出做财务预测或长期计划、评估投资或招聘的财务影响、或压力测试别人的模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭个明年收入模型：从用户数和客单价推出收入，别直接用增长率。
say.note: Claude会按驱动因素拆解并分好三层结构。

say.text: 审查我发你的模型：追踪净利润到输入，找隐藏的硬编码数字。
say.note: 按六步审查法检查，并说明漏洞。

say.text: 帮我把下行情景写成一个连贯故事：如果流失率和薪资都超预期会怎样？
say.note: 它会输出关键假设和下行情景。

howto.what_en: Builds and stress-tests financial models: separates assumptions, calculations, outputs; builds revenue from business drivers; identifies the assumptions that move results most and their breakevens; reviews others' models for hard-coded numbers and hidden assumptions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to do financial forecasting or long-range planning, evaluate the financial impact of an investment or hire, or pressure-test someone else's model.

say_en.text: Build a next-year revenue model from user count and price, not a flat growth rate.
say_en.note: Drivers are decomposed and inputs are placed separately.

say_en.text: Review the model I sent: trace net profit back to inputs and find hard-coded numbers.
say_en.note: Uses the structured review sequence and points out flaws.

say_en.text: Which assumption affects profit most and what is the breakeven point?
say_en.note: Outputs key sensitivities and the downside case.
